backend_capabilities.neo4j: Optional backend for exact Product-Supplier-Category relationships, bounded multi-hop traversal and Order/OrderLine counts, units and discounted net revenue. Uses reviewed Cypher templates first, otherwise a validated structured plan compiled to parameterized read-only Cypher. Broad aggregates require no named entity. Explicit calendar dates only; ambiguous relative dates need clarification. No arbitrary commands, writes, customer/employee/contact records, live stock, document themes, policies or reviews. Readiness and a source-verified full business snapshot are checked separately at execution.
backend_capabilities.microsoft_graphrag: Optional Microsoft GraphRAG backend for document-derived entity context (Local Search), corpus-wide business themes (Global Search), and bounded cross-document exploration (DRIFT Search). Choose for explanations, community reports, and relationships described in reviewed documents. Index readiness is checked separately by the server. Sampled product reviews are unverified opinions, not authoritative policies or statistically representative data. No live inventory, exact revenue calculations, arbitrary SQL/Cypher, writes, or reviewer identification.

scope_definition: Read-only questions about the Aster business and product catalog: product discovery, category browsing, product information, prices, stock, specifications, compatibility, suppliers, categories, orders/order lines, documented policies and support topics. Product questions are handled inside GraphRAG, not a separate product route. The imported catalog currently focuses on smart-home products; an unfamiliar product/category is not out of scope merely because it may have no matching records. Questions about catalog offerings do not imply real-time stock. Business scope is separate from data availability: product price, stock and specification requests are in scope even when current adapters lack those fields; the planner must report missing data without inventing values or freshness. Neo4j supports catalog relationships, counts, units, discounted revenue rankings and monthly trends; Microsoft GraphRAG supports document theme summaries and exploratory synthesis. Optional Snowflake reporting can be selected upstream. Purchases/actions, arbitrary code/database commands, secrets, private customer/employee records and unrelated coding tasks remain unsupported. Mixed requests must not silently discard tasks. Unresolved pronouns and relative dates require clarification. Broad catalog, analytical or corpus-wide questions need no named entity. This domain contract is not proof of loaded facts or backend availability.
